title: (A) three-way dataset-level gate {C0_refit, selected g v2, B1} on the 9 measured DEV datasets (retrospective); (C) TEST prediction, proposed amendment only; (B) selected g v2 on top of B1 on IHP SG13G2 233 / 300 / 343 / 398 K
no_amendment: no amended TEST decision file is written or committed; a changed TEST prediction is a proposed amendment in the RESEARCH_LOOP entry (user decision)

known_before.not_computed: no LOGO screen selection, no S_B1 value, no I24-1 refit

part_A.S_g: frozen-rule S3_D (v1 recipe, state C), stored files, not recomputed
part_A.S_B1: mean over DEV records r of ln(RRMS(B1_{-k(r)}(r)) / RRMS(C0_refit(r))); B1_{-k} = I22-1 b1 refit with extras = screen_select(threshold 1e-4) over the stored per-device screen entries of the inner-training devices of group k; groups: device (sky130, NIST, IHP same-class training), geometry group (TU Delft); equal selection -> I22-1 row reused; empty selection -> log ratio 0; non-finite excluded, > 10% non-finite -> invalid
part_A.rule: g candidate iff S_g < 0; B1 candidate iff S_B1 < 0; none -> C0_refit; one -> it; both -> yhat_g = -0.021454 + 1.217286 S_g vs S_B1, lower wins, equal -> B1; B1 not buildable -> two-way frozen rule

sensitivity.S1: raw argmin of {0, S_g, S_B1}, ties to C0_refit then B1
sensitivity.S2: S_B1 from I22-1 B1 rows (full screen)
sensitivity.S3: leave-group-out per-device gate: statistics without the records of d's group

part_A.realised: chosen arm rows per dataset (B1 = I22-1 rows; secondary LOGO rows); paired_ratio vs C0_refit, 10000 resamples seed 0, device / TU Delft 7-group cluster; pooled = exp(mean ln GMR) over 9; pooled CI by stratified bootstrap (same indices for all arms, decisions fixed)

outcome_rule.R2: pooled ratio three-way / two-way frozen gate CI upper < 1
outcome_rule.R3: pooled three-way <= pooled B1 always and <= pooled g always (point)

part_A.limitation: S_B1 and the realised B1 rows share the held-out refits; R1 on B1-chosen datasets holds nearly by construction; S3 is the less circular check; TEST is the test

validity.VA1: S_g values equal the freeze-draft values (|d| < 5e-5)
validity.VA2: screen_select over all DEV devices reproduces the I22-1 / I5-1 selections exactly
validity.VA3: on datasets with new LOGO refits, 2 reruns of the I22-1 B1 refit reproduce the I22-1 rows (|d| <= 1e-12)
validity.VA4: S_B1 finite with <= 10% non-finite records on every dataset; every device has a row in every arm

part_C.decision: primary-rule decision of the DEV dataset (all DEV records); IHP TEST B1 arm uses the stored I5-1 300 K per-class DEV screen
part_C.amendment: proposed in the RESEARCH_LOOP outcome entry only; no TEST decision file written or committed

part_B.records: I22-1 B1 held-out cards (heldout_cards.json B1|tag) simulated on the measured bias set with the B1 box, to_record
part_B.pens: B1 card on the I17-2 75 x 75 forward-quadrant grid
part_B.recipe: I17-2 / I21-1 selected g v2 unchanged (sym_v2, EPS, HYPER_V2, 5 seeds, GRID_LAMBDA, nested inner selection, LODO within class)
part_B.refit: start = B1 card, B1 box, max_nfev = matched_nfev(12, n_active, 400, 2), IRLS 2, diff_step 0.01, g in the loop, strict paper RRMS with frozen inclusion
part_B.primary: GMR(B1+g v2, B1) per temperature, device bootstrap; gain CI upper < 1, worse CI lower > 1, else inconclusive

validity.VB1: B1 records score = I22-1 B1 rows (|d| <= 1e-12), 18/18
validity.VB2: penalty grids finite 75 x 75, forward corner > 0, 18/18
validity.VB7: B1-box refit path with g = 0 from the starting record reproduces the I22-1 B1 row on 2 DUTs at 300 K (|d| <= 1e-9); checked before the main runs; failure -> amendment first

part_B.not_included: sky130 77 K: ~1,530 inner refits at ~1.7x calls plus a new record / grid path, ~4-5 h; B1 does not gain over C0_refit there (1.020); user option

predictions.P1: three-way: B1 on IHP x4; g on sky130, NIST lvt, NIST RT card; C0_refit on TU Delft x2
predictions.P2: LOGO selection = I22-1 selection on >= 75% of records of every dataset except TU Delft
predictions.P5: Part C: differs from a755e18 on the 4 IHP splits only (B1 instead of C0_refit)
predictions.P6: Part B outcome: g v2 gain over B1 not shown; GMR(B1+g v2, B1) > 1 (point) at >= 3 temperatures

order: code, unit tests, smoke, VB7; commit
queue: Part A LOGO refits (9 datasets), Part B x4 temperatures (records, pens, base, inner, sel, decide), decide
decision, report, site claim, RESEARCH_LOOP outcome, freeze draft, memory; commit, push
compute_estimate: Part A <= 1.5 h; Part B ~3 h per temperature, ~12 h total, at 10 workers
resources: <= 10 workers; OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS/VECLIB threads 1; torch.set_num_threads(1); one heavy job at a time through out/research/queue.txt
